answer_1.quote: With the advancing code capabilities of LLMs, effectively evaluating performance on code-related tasks has emerged as a challenge.
answer_1.outputs: generated code responses including snippets, explanations, and formatting

answer_2.quote: For the code execution benchmarks EvalPlus and MultiPL-E, we extract the expected function and feed the test cases into the extracted function to verify the correctness of the generation and report greedy Pass@1.

answer_3.quote: Due to the high cost of collecting human preferences , we use pairwise comparison for judgment (LLM-as-a-Judge), where an LLM judger is fed with a question and two answers and determines which one is better or declares a tie.
